tests.description: API tests for scheduling lifecycle: create, status, pause, resume, trigger, update, delete — plus error scenarios for 404 and 400
API tests for datasource edge endpoints: active/inactive filters, supplier filter, statistics, validate-name, test-connection, stats
API tests for schema utility endpoints: templates list, validate-json (valid/invalid/inline), regex test (match/no-match/invalid), duplicate, publish
API tests for invalid records bulk operations: bulk delete, reprocess, ignore, export — plus health check and error scenarios
API tests for categories full CRUD: create, read, update, delete, reorder, toggle-active, usage-count — including serial dependency chain and cleanup
API tests for file-operations proxy: list with pattern, write with base64, read — server created/deleted in beforeAll/afterAll
API tests for metrics advanced ops: duplicate, datasource-scoped metrics, global business/system metrics, global-alerts by metric name and enabled filter
API tests for server advanced endpoints: types list, by-type filter, usage-count, toggle-active — with restore step after toggle

knowledge_fragments_used: paginated response wrapper (Data.Items / data.items / bare array)
summary: Generated 8 spec files covering all 8 coverage gaps (G1-G8). Total 78 test cases. G1 (Scheduling) is P0 with 9 tests covering the full scheduling lifecycle and error paths in serial mode. G2-G7 are P1 covering datasource edge endpoints, schema utilities, invalid records bulk ops, categories CRUD, file operations proxy, and metrics advanced ops. G8 is P2 covering server type filtering, usage-count, and toggle-active. All tests use standard Playwright { request } fixture, PascalCase payloads, test.skip() guards for data-dependent tests, and tolerant response status assertions to handle both empty-DB and populated-DB environments. Server setup/teardown uses existing ez-api-client helpers. No hard sleeps used.
